decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core 2K spraying competence into heavy corrosion protection markets, so it is likely to be kept despite only being mentioned on the website.
The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established offer, has its own product page, and serves construction repair customers, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.
The low-pressure transfer pump complements the firm's material conveying portfolio with low incremental cost, so it is likely to be retained.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports quality-assured intumescent coating application and the firm's digitalization goals, and it has its own page, so it will likely be kept.
